name: Cashback SBI Card
reviewTips: April 2026 revision: 5% online capped at ₹2,000 and 1% offline capped at ₹2,000 per statement cycle. Check gaming, tolls and government were added to exclusions.

name: Amazon Pay ICICI

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Credited as Amazon Pay balance, not statement credit.

reviewTips: Expect two Amazon rules: 5% that needs amazon_prime, and a lower rate without it. Also 2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants. Exclusions matter here: ICICI's card terms (not the product page) list no cashback on fuel, rent, EMI, education, tax/government and international spends, and flights/hotels via Amazon Pay don't get the 5%/3% rate. If the proposal has no exclusions, re-run with the terms PDF as a second --source.

name: Axis Bank ACE
reviewTips: Axis updated ACE terms from 28 Aug 2026: if the PDF predates that, find the revision link on the card page. Bill payments via Google Pay should map to the gpay_bill merchant.

name: Airtel Axis Bank
reviewTips: Network not verified. The 25% Airtel cap is 'twice the base cashback earned that month', which the app can't represent; the agent should note it rather than invent a fixed cap.

name: HDFC Millennia
reviewTips: 5% on 10 named merchants (Amazon, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Flipkart, Myntra, Sony LIV, Swiggy, Tata CLiQ, Uber, Zomato), 1% elsewhere, each with a monthly CashPoint cap. Check the PDF's date: terms changed in 2026.

name: Flipkart SBI Card
reviewTips: Network not verified. Expect Myntra, Flipkart and Cleartrip rules plus a preferred-partners rate. If the card page comes back thin, save it as PDF.

name: Tata Neu Plus HDFC

reward.inrPerUnitNote: 1 NeuCoin = ₹1, usable only on Tata Neu and Tata brands.

reviewTips: UPI has two rates: a low one on any UPI app and a higher one via your Tata Neu UPI ID (should need partner_upi_app), all capped at 500 NeuCoins/month.

name: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC

reward.inrPerUnitNote: 1 NeuCoin = ₹1, usable only on Tata Neu and Tata brands.

reviewTips: 5% on Tata brands, 1.5% elsewhere. UPI: 0.5% on any app vs 1.5% via Tata Neu UPI ID (partner_upi_app), capped at 500 NeuCoins/month. Grocery points capped at 2,000/month.

name: Kiwi RuPay (YES / AU / PNB)
issuer: Kiwi with YES Bank, AU Bank or PNB
reviewTips: Base 1.5% on UPI scan & pay through the Kiwi app (partner_upi_app). Ignore paid Neon membership rates for now; note them.

name: Axis super.money RuPay
reviewTips: Terms changed on 1 Jan 2026 (UPI rate reworked, sub-₹100 spends excluded). Make sure the proposal reflects the 2026 version, not the 2025 launch terms.

name: Swiggy BLCK HDFC
reviewTips: This PDF covers both Ornge and BLCK: make sure only BLCK rates are used (10% Swiggy, 5% online, 1% other capped ₹1,000).

name: Swiggy Ornge HDFC
reviewTips: This PDF covers both Ornge and BLCK: make sure only Ornge rates are used (5% Swiggy and online sharing one ₹1,500 cap).

name: HDFC Regalia Gold

reward.inrPerUnitNote: ₹0.50 is a typical value (flights/hotels via SmartBuy or vouchers); statement credit is worth less.

reviewTips: From 15 May 2026: 5 points per ₹200. SmartBuy multipliers aren't modelled in v1; the agent should note them, not add them as rules.

name: ICICI Coral RuPay

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Typical catalogue/voucher value; varies by redemption.

reviewTips: 2 points per ₹100 (not fuel), 1 point per ₹100 on utilities and insurance. Same on UPI.

name: HSBC RuPay Cashback
reviewTips: Requested by a user. Reviews describe 10% on dining, food delivery and groceries under one combined monthly cap (about ₹400), and 1% on everything else including UPI. Check the cap amount and whether UPI spends earn the 10% too. If the page comes back thin, add HSBC's cashback T&C PDF linked from that page.

name: HDFC MoneyBack+
reviewTips: Network not verified (issued on Visa and Mastercard). The product page links changes effective 15 May 2026; the T&C PDF is from April 2025, so where they differ the 15 May 2026 change wins. Expect 10X (20 CashPoints per ₹150) on Amazon, BigBasket, Flipkart, Reliance Smart SuperStore and Swiggy with a monthly cap, and 2 CashPoints per ₹150 elsewhere. Map Reliance Smart SuperStore to reliance_smart and Swiggy to swiggy_food + swiggy_instamart only if the document says Swiggy broadly.

name: SimplyCLICK SBI Card
reviewTips: 10 points per ₹100 on exclusive online partners (list in the document, e.g. Apollo 24/7, BookMyShow, Cleartrip, Domino's, Myntra, Netmeds, Swiggy, Yatra), 5 per ₹100 on other ONLINE spends (channels: online), 1 per ₹100 otherwise. Each accelerated bucket has its own 10,000-point monthly cap with overflow to base. Amazon and Flipkart are 'other online', not partners. Partners not in the merchant list go in notes.

name: SimplySAVE SBI Card
reviewTips: 10 points per ₹150 on dining, movies, departmental stores and grocery; 1 per ₹150 elsewhere. Check for a monthly cap on the 10X bucket. If the page comes back empty (JavaScript), save it as PDF and pass it with --source. A RuPay variant exists; this entry is the Visa card.

name: BPCL SBI Card OCTANE
reviewTips: 25 points per ₹100 at BPCL fuel (merchant bpcl only, NOT the fuel category: other pumps earn nothing), capped at 2,500 points per billing cycle. 10 per ₹100 on dining, movies, grocery and departmental stores with its own monthly cap. 1 per ₹100 elsewhere; fuel at non-BPCL pumps excluded. The press release is from 2020: where the product page differs, the page wins. The 1% surcharge waiver is not a reward; leave it out.

name: Axis Bank MY Zone

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Typical EDGE catalogue value; varies by redemption.

reviewTips: Expect 4 EDGE points per ₹200 as base. Check the April 2026 revision for any changed earn rates or exclusions. The EDGE REWARDS terms cover many cards: use only MY Zone's rows. Swiggy/District discounts are offers, not reward rules; leave them out.

name: Axis Bank Atlas

reward.inrPerUnitNote: 1 EDGE Mile = ₹1 on Axis Travel EDGE; partner transfers can be worth more.

reviewTips: Network not verified. 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on direct airline and hotel bookings and Axis Travel EDGE: use merchants airline and hotel ONLY, no travel category (MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Cleartrip and other OTAs earn the base rate). Check for a monthly spend cap on the 5X. 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 elsewhere. Milestones and tiers are not per-payment rules; put them in notes. Axis has paused new applications.

name: ICICI HPCL Super Saver

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Typical value; check the document for the cashback-equivalent rate.

reviewTips: Fuel rate applies at HPCL only (merchant hpcl, not the fuel category), with a monthly cap; HP Pay adds a little more (needs the HP Pay app, leave it in notes). Higher rate on utilities, grocery and departmental stores with its own monthly cap. ICICI changed caps from 1 Feb 2026: make sure the document is current. If the document states cashback in ₹ rather than points, say so in notes so the unit can be fixed. A RuPay variant exists; this entry is the Visa card.

name: Amex Membership Rewards Credit Card

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Gold Collection vouchers value MR points at about ₹0.4–0.5; statement credit is ₹0.25.

reviewTips: 1 MR point per ₹50 on most spends; no points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash and merchant EMI (exclusions). The monthly bonuses (1,000 points for 4 transactions of ₹1,500+; 1,000 for ₹20,000 a month, enrolment needed) are milestones, not per-payment rules: put them in notes. Amex has paused new MRCC applications in India.

name: Amex Platinum Travel

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Gold Collection vouchers value MR points at about ₹0.4–0.5; statement credit is ₹0.25.

reviewTips: 1 MR point per ₹50 on most spends, same exclusions as other Amex credit cards. The card's value is in milestones (₹1.9 lakh and ₹4 lakh a year): put them in notes, not rules. Amex has paused new applications in India.

name: IDFC FIRST Millennia
reviewTips: 3X on spends up to ₹20,000 a month is the base. The 10X on incremental spend above ₹20,000 a month and the birthday 10X can't be modelled per payment: put them in notes. Check the May 2026 communication for changed rates or exclusions (fuel, EMI, insurance, rent usually earn nothing).
